name: Malformed declarations refuse; absent budget stays 30; unregister retires
detail: All malformed/duplicate declarations refused with exit 2 and no trust; absent declaration exported 30; unregister removed script and trust.

name: Authenticated check runs longer than former 30s cap
detail: Real registered check completed after 31s under its authenticated 36s budget, exceeding the unchanged 30s default.

name: Both timeout engines publish named measured cuts and continue the sweep
detail: Installed timeout and portable Perl paths retained partial output, cut late output, named tool/budget/positive measured seconds, then ran the later check with default 30.

name: Budget tampering invalidates authentication before execution
detail: Changing only authenticated budget bytes after registration prevented execution and generated an unauthenticated-check notification.

name: Checkpoint ordering, deferral, remaining-window admission and ordinary full budget
detail: Foreground checks ran by ascending budget then name; oversized 300s check was deferred in the 180s window and in a quiet 2s window; admission rechecked remaining time; ordinary watcher retained 300s.

name: Long admitted check retains monitoring health and ownership
detail: After 5s of active check execution, a 4s stall bound did not evict the original watcher: duplicate start reported its same PID, beacon age stayed under 3s, and original completed/published.
